main.description:
A time-bounded declaration of live game activity, one per account.

Active sessions should update staleAt regularly (e.g. every 5–15 minutes). Consumers must treat records as abandoned when now > staleAt.

Applications must obtain explicit owner consent before publishing presence, and respect player privacy and covert play preferences.

game.description: AT-URI reference to the game definition record (e.g. games.atmosphere.define or games.gamesgamesgamesgames.game).

platform.description: Optional AT-URI reference to a platform record (e.g. games.gamesgamesgamesgames.platform). Not bound to any single namespace by the schema itself; the referenced collection may change over time without requiring a Lexicon revision here.

state.description: Human-readable summary of the current session (e.g. 'Daily Challenge', 'Ranked Match').

details.description: Detailed task, event, or countdown progress within the session.

playing.description: Multiplayer or party details. Presence indicates active playing rather than passive watching.

embed.description: External card embed for rich social feed rendering.

createdAt.description: Beginning of the overall play session.

staleAt.description: Timestamp after which consumers should consider this activity abandoned.

via.description: Identifier for the client or launcher managing this record (e.g. atmosphere.games).

details.description: Progress or event details for the current session.

event.description: Name of the ongoing event or task (e.g. 'Level 5-2', 'Turn 14 of 20').

startedAt.description: Start timestamp of the current event, used for count-up displays.

endsAt.description: End timestamp of the current event, used for count-down displays.

id.description: Unique session identifier shared across all participants in the party.

party.description: Party capacity and participant identity list.

current.description: Number of players currently in the party.

dids.description: DIDs of players in the party who have AT Protocol accounts.
